title: Orang Pendek and surviving Flores hominids

tellings.quote: speculate about is the Orang Pendek in Indonesia.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speculates about the Orang Pendek, a short, human-like creature some people say lives in the forests of Indonesia. He raises it alongside the idea that small ancient human relatives once known from the island of Flores might have survived. If so, it would mean other human-like beings still share the planet with us.
